topAgencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Health and Human Services

forecast.forecastDesc: The Delta Rural Integrated Health Network Program seeks to improve healthcare delivery in the region by supporting the development of integrated health networks among rural hospitals, primary care clinics, behavioral health providers and other essential services.
forecast.applicantEligibilityDesc: Successful applications must target rural healthcare organizations located in the Delta region.
forecast.estApplicationResponseDateDesc: Electronically submitted applications must be submitted no later than 11:59 p.m., ET, on the listed application due date.
forecast.modComments: Revised timeline for estimated post date.
